# programming language

- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/programmingLanguage>

A programming language a software project is implemented in — a [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) (the language slice's [`ProgrammingLanguage`](../classes/gmeow-ProgrammingLanguage.md)).
